# team-a's eight series and the three global gauges are TRANSCRIBED from the capability experiment
# of 2026-08-28 against 0.3.12.post1. team-b is RECONSTRUCTED: the experiment recorded the global
# mooncake_tenant_quota_requested_bytes_sum as 5368709120, which is more than team-a asked for, so a
# second tenant requesting the remaining 4294967296 is what makes the recorded total add up. Its
# figures are derived from a measured one; they were never observed on their own.
